streams.pump_role: HPLC pump for liquid substrate delivery
streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Liquid substrate solution. Flow rate derived from Engineering Design Calculations Step 3 (Q_total = 0.500 mL/min).

streams.pump_role: Mass Flow Controller (MFC) for gas delivery
streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Gaseous reductant. Flow rate derived from Engineering Design Calculations Step 9 (H2 MFC = 3.36 sccm).

mixer_type: Static mixer or T-mixer with back-pressure retention
mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: H2 gas and liquid substrate mixed before entering packed bed to ensure saturation. Engineering calculations indicate Da > 1, so efficient mixing is critical to avoid mass transfer limitations.
pre_reactor_steps: Mix Stream A (Liquid) and Stream B (H2 Gas) using a static mixer or gas-liquid contactor.
Heat mixture to 50 C using a pre-heater coil or jacketed mixer.
Apply back-pressure to maintain system pressure at 10 bar (via BPR downstream) to ensure H2 solubility.
post_reactor_steps: Pass effluent through a filter or frit to retain Pd/C catalyst particles.
Depressurize via BPR (set to 10 bar) to vent excess H2 safely.
chemistry_notes: Heterogeneous hydrogenation of alkene over Pd/C. Gas-liquid-solid system. Engineering calculations indicate significant axial dispersion (Pe=92) and mass transfer limitations (Da=6.24). A packed bed reactor is required for catalyst retention. BPR is mandatory to maintain H2 solubility and prevent degassing. No photochemistry involved. Temperature 50 C is moderate, requiring PFA or SS tubing.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Engineering Design Calculations Step 2: tau = 8.0 min. This is within the estimated range [5.3-12.0] min. Based on in-channel pressure-corrected time.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. In-channel time accounts for gas expansion/compression effects on residence time. Inlet time is lower due to gas compression at 10 bar.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: From Batch Input and Chemistry Plan: 50 C. Maintained to ensure reaction kinetics and catalyst activity.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Design Calculations Step 8: BPR REQUIRED. Batch condition is 10 bar H2. BPR set to 10 bar to maintain pressure and H2 solubility.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA is suitable for 50 C and chemical compatibility with ethanol/H2. SS could also be used but PFA allows for easier packing and cleaning.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: From Batch Input: 0.1 M. Maintained to match batch kinetics and avoid mass transfer issues at higher concentrations.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Packed bed is required for heterogeneous catalyst (Pd/C) retention. Engineering calculations assume packed bed geometry.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: Engineering Design Calculations Step 3: d = 1.00 mm. This ID balances pressure drop and axial dispersion.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Engineering Design Calculations Step 3: V_R = 26.67 mL. Calculated from tau and flow rate.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: No photochemistry involved. Chemistry Plan confirms thermal reaction.
reasoning_per_field.deoxygenation_method: Chemistry Plan states deoxygenation not strictly required, but O2 competes for active sites. H2 atmosphere provides inerting. No specific deoxygenation step needed beyond H2 purge.
